elected.title: Mayor — Zohran Mamdani
elected.text: Chief executive of city government. Appoints agency commissioners and Deputy Mayors. Proposes the city budget. Took office January 1, 2026.

elected.title: Comptroller — Mark Levine
elected.text: Independent financial watchdog. Audits city agencies, manages pension funds, reviews contracts. Took office January 1, 2026.

elected.title: Public Advocate — Jumaane Williams
elected.text: Ombudsman for New Yorkers. Investigates complaints against city agencies and serves as first in line of mayoral succession.

deputies.title: First Deputy Mayor — Dean Fuleihan
deputies.text: Coordinates all Deputy Mayors. Supervises fiscal operations and the city’s criminal justice, education, and financial agencies. Second in command if the Mayor is unable to perform duties.

agencies.name: OMB — Office of Management & Budget
agencies.text: Prepares the city’s annual budget and tracks spending across all agencies. CB6 submits annual budget priorities to OMB.

agencies.name: DOF — Dept of Finance
agencies.text: Collects taxes, assesses property values, and processes payments. Property tax assessments affect every lot in CB6.

agencies.name: NYPD — NYC Police Department
agencies.text: CB6 is served by the 76th Precinct (Carroll Gardens/Red Hook) and 78th Precinct (Park Slope/Gowanus).

agencies.name: DOC — Dept of Correction
agencies.text: Operates the city jail system including Rikers Island and borough facilities.

agencies.name: DOProbation — Dept of Probation
agencies.text: Supervises people on city probation and administers community service programs.

agencies.name: NYC Public Schools
agencies.text: Operates NYC’s public school system. CB6 includes PS 58, PS 29, PS 32, MS 51, and other schools in the district.

agencies.name: SCA — School Construction Authority
agencies.text: Plans and builds new school buildings and manages capital improvements to existing schools.

agencies.name: CUNY — City University of New York
agencies.text: 25-campus public university system. Chancellor appointed by a Board of Trustees.

agencies.name: MOCJ — Mayor’s Office of Criminal Justice
agencies.text: Coordinates criminal justice policy across agencies. Includes Office to Prevent Hate Crimes, Office to Prevent Gun Violence, and Office of Special Enforcement.

agencies.name: OLR — Office of Labor Relations
agencies.text: Negotiates and administers labor contracts for city employees.

agencies.name: BIC — Business Integrity Commission
agencies.text: Regulates trade waste and wholesale markets to prevent corruption and organized crime infiltration.

agencies.name: CIDI — Center for Innovation through Data Intelligence
agencies.text: Supports data-driven policymaking and inter-agency data sharing across city government.

agencies.name: Office of Childcare & Early Childhood Education
agencies.text: Coordinates the city’s childcare and pre-K programs across agencies.

deputies.title: Deputy Mayor for Housing & Planning — Leila Bozorg
deputies.text: Oversees housing production, land use, tenant protection, and community development. Most directly relevant to CB6’s ULURP reviews, Gowanus rezoning implementation, and historic districts.

agencies.name: NYCHA — NYC Housing Authority
agencies.text: CB6 includes Gowanus Houses and Wyckoff Gardens. Approximately $200M in capital investment was secured through the 2021 Gowanus rezoning.

agencies.name: HPD — Dept of Housing Preservation & Development
agencies.text: Finances and regulates affordable housing. Administers MIH and related programs central to CB6’s housing work.

agencies.name: DCP — Dept of City Planning
agencies.text: Develops land use policy, manages zoning, and runs ULURP. CB6 interacts with DCP on every land use application in the district.

agencies.name: DOB — Dept of Buildings
agencies.text: Issues permits, inspects construction, and enforces building code. CB6 tracks DOB activity via the dashboard’s address lookup.

agencies.name: LPC — Landmarks Preservation Commission
agencies.text: Designates and regulates historic landmarks and districts. CB6 has six historic districts and reviews Certificate of Appropriateness applications.

agencies.name: PDC — Public Design Commission
agencies.text: Reviews proposed works of art, architecture, and landscape on city-owned property.

agencies.name: OPT — Office to Protect Tenants
agencies.text: Coordinates city efforts to prevent tenant harassment, displacement, and illegal evictions.

agencies.name: OHR — Office of Housing Recovery Operations
agencies.text: Manages post-disaster housing recovery programs including Sandy rebuild initiatives still active in Red Hook.

deputies.title: Deputy Mayor for Economic Justice — Julia Su
deputies.text: Oversees economic development, small business, consumer protection, workforce, culture, and immigrant affairs.

agencies.name: EDC — Economic Development Corporation
agencies.text: Leads major city development projects including the Brooklyn Marine Terminal redevelopment adjacent to CB6.

agencies.name: SBS — Dept of Small Business Services
agencies.text: Supports small businesses with permits, workforce development, and commercial corridor programs. Includes Office of Nightlife.

agencies.name: DCWP — Dept of Consumer & Worker Protection
agencies.text: Enforces consumer protection and labor standards, licenses businesses, and investigates complaints.

agencies.name: TLC — Taxi & Limousine Commission
agencies.text: Regulates yellow cabs, green cars, and app-based rideshare services citywide.

agencies.name: DCLA — Dept of Cultural Affairs
agencies.text: Funds and supports NYC’s museums, theaters, and cultural institutions.

agencies.name: MOME — Office of Media & Entertainment
agencies.text: Supports NYC’s media and entertainment industries. Includes NYC Media and the Office of Film, Theater & Broadcasting.

agencies.name: NYC Tourism + Conventions
agencies.text: Promotes NYC as a travel destination and manages convention business.

agencies.name: CHR — Commission on Human Rights
agencies.text: Enforces NYC’s Human Rights Law prohibiting discrimination in employment, housing, and public accommodations.

agencies.name: OIA — Office of Immigrant Affairs
agencies.text: Connects immigrant New Yorkers to city services and advocates for immigrant-inclusive policies.

agencies.name: OTWD — Office of Talent & Workforce Development
agencies.text: Coordinates workforce training and career development programs across the city.

agencies.name: M/WBE Office
agencies.text: Promotes and certifies Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprises for city contracting.

agencies.name: OEO — Office for Economic Opportunity
agencies.text: Coordinates anti-poverty programs and measures socioeconomic outcomes across agencies.

agencies.name: Office of Racial Equity
agencies.text: Coordinates equity initiatives citywide. Includes Young Men’s Initiative, Commission on Gender Equity, Pay Equity Cabinet, and NYC Her Future.

deputies.title: Deputy Mayor for Operations — Julia Kerson
deputies.text: Oversees the agencies that keep the city running day to day — streets, sanitation, parks, environment, infrastructure, and technology.

agencies.name: DOT — Dept of Transportation
agencies.text: Manages city streets, bridges, traffic signals, and bike infrastructure. Relevant to CB6’s street safety work and Sammy’s Law implementation.

agencies.name: DEP — Dept of Environmental Protection
agencies.text: Manages water supply, wastewater, and the Gowanus Canal Superfund and Red Hook CSO facility.

agencies.name: DSNY — Dept of Sanitation
agencies.text: Collects trash and recycling, manages composting, and clears snow.

agencies.name: DPR — Dept of Parks & Recreation
agencies.text: Operates NYC’s 30,000+ acres of parkland including Prospect Park, within CB6’s service area.

agencies.name: FDNY — Fire Department of New York
agencies.text: Responds to fires, medical emergencies, and hazmat incidents across CB6.

agencies.name: DDC — Dept of Design & Construction
agencies.text: Manages capital construction projects for city agencies.

agencies.name: DCAS — Dept of Citywide Administrative Services
agencies.text: Manages city facilities, procurement, fleet, and HR systems.

agencies.name: OEM — Office of Emergency Management
agencies.text: Coordinates citywide emergency preparedness and response, including hurricane and flood planning relevant to Red Hook.

agencies.name: Office of Climate & Environmental Justice
agencies.text: Coordinates the city’s climate action and environmental justice work across agencies.

agencies.name: Office of Technology & Innovation
agencies.text: Manages citywide technology infrastructure and digital services.

agencies.name: Office of Capital Project Development
agencies.text: Coordinates major capital projects across city agencies.

agencies.name: DORIS — Dept of Records & Information Services
agencies.text: Manages city government records and maintains the NYC Municipal Archives.

agencies.name: Mayor’s Office of Data Analytics
agencies.text: Coordinates data sharing and analytics across city agencies to improve service delivery.

deputies.title: Deputy Mayor for Health & Human Services — Helen Arteaga-Landaverde
deputies.text: Oversees healthcare, social services, children’s services, aging, and human welfare programs.

agencies.name: H+H — NYC Health + Hospitals
agencies.text: NYC’s public hospital system — 11 hospitals serving all New Yorkers regardless of ability to pay.

agencies.name: DSS — Dept of Social Services (HRA + DHS)
agencies.text: Administers SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, and homeless services. Includes the Human Resources Administration and Department of Homeless Services.

agencies.name: DOHMH — Dept of Health & Mental Hygiene
agencies.text: Regulates and monitors public health across the city.

agencies.name: ACS — Administration for Children’s Services
agencies.text: Protects children from abuse and neglect, manages foster care and adoption.

agencies.name: DYCD — Dept of Youth & Community Development
agencies.text: Funds youth development programs, afterschool, and community-based organizations across CB6.

agencies.name: DFTA — Dept for the Aging
agencies.text: Funds and coordinates services for older New Yorkers including senior centers in CB6.

agencies.name: OCME — Office of the Chief Medical Examiner
agencies.text: Conducts forensic investigations and medicolegal death investigations for the city.

agencies.name: ENDGBV — Office to End Domestic & Gender-Based Violence
agencies.text: Coordinates city response to domestic violence and gender-based violence.

agencies.name: DVS — Dept of Veterans’ Services
agencies.text: Connects NYC veterans to benefits, housing, employment, and support services.

agencies.name: Office of Community Mental Health
agencies.text: Coordinates mental health services across city agencies and community providers.

agencies.name: Office of Food Policy
agencies.text: Coordinates the city’s food access programs and food system planning.

agencies.name: Office for People with Disabilities
agencies.text: Ensures city services and infrastructure are accessible to New Yorkers with disabilities.

deputies.title: Deputy Mayor for Community Safety — Renita Francois
deputies.text: Added by Executive Order No. 15 (March 2026). Oversees the new Office of Community Safety and coordinates civilian-led safety programs. Smaller portfolio than other deputy mayors but central to Mamdani’s public safety agenda.

agencies.name: OCS — Office of Community Safety
agencies.text: New citywide office established by EO15. Coordinates civilian-led safety responses including mental health crisis response and community outreach.

agencies.name: B-HEARD — Behavioral Health Emergency Assistance Response
agencies.text: Civilian mental health response program that sends mental health professionals instead of police to certain 911 calls involving mental health crises.

agencies.name: Office of Crime Victim Services
agencies.text: Coordinates services and support for crime victims across city agencies.

agencies.name: Office of Gun Violence Prevention
agencies.text: Coordinates the city’s gun violence prevention strategy and community-based intervention programs.

agencies.name: Office for Prevention of Hate Crimes
agencies.text: Coordinates the city’s response to hate crimes and works with affected communities.

elected.title: Governor — Kathy Hochul
elected.text: Chief executive of New York State. Appoints agency commissioners and proposes the state budget. First female Governor of New York, took office August 2021. Running for a second full term in 2026. governor.ny.gov ↗

elected.title: Lieutenant Governor — Antonio Delgado
elected.text: Presides over the State Senate, succeeds the Governor if the office becomes vacant. Appointed 2022, elected to full term November 2022. governor.ny.gov ↗

elected.title: Attorney General — Letitia James
elected.text: Independent legal officer of the state. Represents New York in legal matters, investigates fraud, enforces consumer protection and civil rights laws. ag.ny.gov ↗

elected.title: Comptroller — Thomas DiNapoli
elected.text: Independent financial watchdog. Audits state agencies, manages the state pension fund, reviews state contracts. osc.ny.gov ↗

deputies.title: Housing & Community Renewal
deputies.text: The state's primary housing agencies — most directly relevant to CB6's work on affordable housing, Gowanus rezoning implementation, and tenant protections.

agencies.name: HCR — Homes & Community Renewal
agencies.text: Finances and regulates affordable housing statewide. Administers LIHTC, HOME, and other programs that fund projects in CB6.

agencies.name: HFA — Housing Finance Agency
agencies.text: Issues tax-exempt bonds to finance affordable housing developments across New York State.

agencies.name: SONYMA — Mortgage Agency
agencies.text: Provides low-interest mortgages to first-time homebuyers across New York State.

agencies.name: DHCR — Housing & Community Renewal
agencies.text: Administers rent regulation programs including rent stabilization and rent control for NYC tenants.

deputies.title: Transportation & Infrastructure
deputies.text: State agencies overseeing transportation infrastructure, bridges, and transit — directly relevant to CB6's street safety and transit work.

agencies.name: DOT — Dept of Transportation
agencies.text: Manages state highways, bridges, and coordinates with NYC DOT. Oversees MTA capital funding and Sammy's Law implementation at state level.

agencies.name: MTA — Metropolitan Transportation Authority
agencies.text: State-created public authority operating NYC subway, buses, LIRR, Metro-North, and bridges/tunnels. CB6 is served by multiple subway lines.

agencies.name: Thruway Authority
agencies.text: Operates and maintains the New York State Thruway system.

agencies.name: DMV — Dept of Motor Vehicles
agencies.text: Licenses drivers, registers vehicles, and administers traffic safety programs statewide.

deputies.title: Health & Human Services
deputies.text: Agencies providing direct services to New Yorkers — healthcare, income support, child welfare, and mental health.

agencies.name: DOH — Dept of Health
agencies.text: Regulates hospitals and health facilities, administers Medicaid, oversees public health programs across the state.

agencies.name: OTDA — Office of Temporary & Disability Assistance
agencies.text: Administers SNAP, cash assistance, and homeless services programs.

agencies.name: OCFS — Office of Children & Family Services
agencies.text: Oversees child welfare, foster care, juvenile justice, and daycare programs.

agencies.name: OMH — Office of Mental Health
agencies.text: Operates state psychiatric centers and licenses community mental health programs.

agencies.name: OASAS — Addiction Services
agencies.text: Regulates and funds addiction treatment and prevention services across New York.

deputies.title: Environment & Energy
deputies.text: State agencies managing environmental protection, climate, and energy — highly relevant to CB6's Gowanus Canal Superfund work and climate resilience.

agencies.name: DEC — Dept of Environmental Conservation
agencies.text: Regulates air, water, and land quality. Oversees Superfund cleanup — including the Gowanus Canal — and statewide environmental permitting.

agencies.name: NYSERDA — Energy R&D Authority
agencies.text: Advances clean energy technology, administers energy efficiency programs, and funds offshore wind development.

agencies.name: PSC — Public Service Commission
agencies.text: Regulates electric, gas, water, and telecom utilities. Sets Con Edison rates that affect CB6 residents and businesses.

deputies.title: Economic Development & Labor
deputies.text: Agencies supporting businesses, workers, and economic growth across New York State.

agencies.name: ESD — Empire State Development
agencies.text: State's primary economic development agency. Provides business incentives, manages the Brooklyn Marine Terminal redevelopment at the state level.

agencies.name: DOL — Dept of Labor
agencies.text: Enforces state labor laws, administers unemployment insurance, and oversees workplace safety.

agencies.name: DFS — Dept of Financial Services
agencies.text: Regulates banks, insurance companies, and mortgage lenders operating in New York State.

agencies.name: DOS — Dept of State
agencies.text: Provides local government support, licenses professionals, oversees community development programs, and administers the SLA.

agencies.name: SLA — State Liquor Authority
agencies.text: Issues and regulates all liquor licenses in New York State. CB6 reviews applications and submits recommendations to the SLA.

agencies.name: Tax & Finance
agencies.text: Collects state taxes and administers tax programs including the property tax cap that affects NYC budgeting.

deputies.title: Public Safety
deputies.text: State agencies responsible for law enforcement, corrections, and emergency management.

agencies.name: NYSP — State Police
agencies.text: Statewide law enforcement agency. Patrols state highways and assists local agencies.

agencies.name: DOCCS — Corrections & Community Supervision
agencies.text: Operates state prisons and supervises people on parole.

agencies.name: DHSES — Homeland Security & Emergency Services
agencies.text: Coordinates emergency preparedness and response, including for natural disasters and infrastructure failures.

agencies.name: DCJS — Criminal Justice Services
agencies.text: Collects crime statistics, manages criminal records, and coordinates criminal justice policy.

deputies.title: Education
deputies.text: The State Education Department is unique — its commissioner is appointed by the Board of Regents, not the Governor.

agencies.name: NYSED — State Education Dept
agencies.text: Sets education policy, oversees school districts, and grants professional licenses. The Commissioner is appointed by the Board of Regents.

agencies.name: SUNY — State University of NY
agencies.text: 64-campus public university system. Chancellor appointed by a Board of Trustees.

agencies.name: CUNY — City University of NY
agencies.text: 25-campus public university system serving New York City. Chancellor appointed by a Board of Trustees.

deputies.title: NY State Senate — 63 Members
deputies.text: Majority Leader: Andrea Stewart-Cousins. Confirms gubernatorial appointments. Democrats hold a 41-22 majority as of 2026.

deputies.title: NY State Assembly — 150 Members
deputies.text: Speaker: Carl Heastie. The lower house of the state legislature. Democrats hold a strong majority. CB6 is served by Assembly Districts 44 and 52.
